title: School World
content: I’m 35 and haven’t been near a school in decades but I still occasionally have the stress dream where “something happened to your permanent record and now you have to do school all over again”. I’m sure we’ve all had some variation of this nightmare. Anyway, the school is all of my schools condensed into a crazy MC Escher building where there are no stairs between the floors and you just sort of float between the floors, and the surrounding neighborhood is also a amalgam of all the neighborhoods my schools were in with buses that seem to phase in and out of existence. Does this resonate with anyone?
